system.name: FinalMLP
system.one_liner: Two-stream MLP for CTR prediction with stream-specific feature gating and multi-head bilinear fusion of the two stream outputs.

content.variant_note: central layer-by-layer framework with two enlarged zoom panels tied to it by orange dashed leader lines
content.argues: A plain two-stream MLP is upgraded by two plug-in layers: stream-specific feature selection at the input and bilinear fusion at the output.
content.subject: Bottom-up two-stream CTR framework with the feature-selection gate and the bilinear and multi-head bilinear fusion enlarged beside it.

elements.name: Input
elements.role: raw feature fields of one record, one box per field
elements.drawn_as: bold layer label plus a row of white boxes holding circles marked 0 or 1 (grey for 1) and one box with 0.7

elements.name: Embedding
elements.role: turns each input field into an embedding vector
elements.drawn_as: light-green band holding boxes of three lavender circles, '......' between them

elements.name: Feature Selection
elements.role: stream-specific gating of the concatenated embeddings, giving each stream its own weighted input
elements.drawn_as: orange rounded box with two arrows fanning out to the streams

elements.name: Network 1 / Network 2
elements.role: the two parallel streams that learn feature interactions
elements.drawn_as: two cyan trapezoids, narrower at the top

elements.name: Output 1 / Output 2
elements.role: stream outputs handed to the fusion
elements.drawn_as: two light-blue rectangles above the trapezoids

elements.name: Fusion
elements.role: merges the two stream outputs into the prediction
elements.drawn_as: pale-yellow rounded box with dashed leaders to panel (c)

elements.name: pCTR
elements.role: predicted click-through rate
elements.drawn_as: plain text on the arrow leaving Fusion

elements.name: Output / Fusion / Two-Stream Feature Interaction / Feature Selection / Embedding / Input
elements.role: names the six layers of the framework
elements.drawn_as: bold serif labels in a left column, split by dashed horizontal rules

elements.name: (unlabelled) dashed row of embedding groups
elements.role: the concatenated embeddings that enter both gates
elements.drawn_as: dashed box with groups of three lavender circles and '…'

elements.name: user features / item features
elements.role: conditional features that drive each gate: a user view for stream 1, an item view for stream 2
elements.drawn_as: two small boxes of coloured circles with '…' (green for user, yellow and brown for item)

elements.name: MLP
elements.role: gating network that turns the conditional features into gate values
elements.drawn_as: two white rounded boxes, one per stream

elements.name: σ and 2x
elements.role: sigmoid followed by a multiplier of 2, so gate weights lie in [0, 2]
elements.drawn_as: small circle with σ and an arrow labelled 2x

elements.role: element-wise product of the embeddings and the gate weights
elements.drawn_as: small circle with a dot, one per stream

elements.name: Stream 1 / Stream 2
elements.role: weighted feature outputs passed on to each stream
elements.drawn_as: plain labels at the heads of two upward arrows

elements.name: Bilinear Fusion (BF)
elements.role: combines the stream outputs o1 and o2 through weighted sums that include a cross term
elements.drawn_as: small tree: o1 and o2 in boxes of circles, three sum nodes, a middle box with a 2x2 circle grid

elements.name: o1, o2
elements.role: the two stream outputs entering the fusion
elements.drawn_as: boxes of two circles, light blue for o1 and darker blue for o2

elements.name: w1, w2, W3
elements.role: weights beside the left sum, the right sum and the middle cross-term box (reading of the drawing)
elements.drawn_as: serif math symbols beside the Σ nodes and the middle box

elements.name: Σ
elements.role: sums the branches
elements.drawn_as: circles with Σ: three in the BF drawing, one on top of the multi-head drawing

elements.name: Multi-Head Bilinear Fusion
elements.role: cuts o1 and o2 into k chunks each, applies BF blocks to the chunks and sums their outputs
elements.drawn_as: row of BF boxes over two rows of chunk boxes with a Σ on top

elements.name: o11 … o1k / o21 … o2k
elements.role: the k chunks of o1 and of o2
elements.drawn_as: small boxes with subscripted labels, light blue for o1 chunks and darker blue for o2 chunks

elements.name: Chunking
elements.role: splits o1 and o2 into pieces
elements.drawn_as: small up arrow and a bracket under each chunk row, labelled Chunking, with o1 and o2 below

elements.name: BF
elements.role: one bilinear fusion head of the multi-head layer
elements.drawn_as: small white rectangles labelled BF with '…' between them

summary: FinalMLP is a CTR-prediction model built from two parallel MLP streams plus two plug-in layers: a stream-specific feature-selection gate in front of the streams and a bilinear fusion layer behind them. The figure is a model-anatomy overview with zoom. Panel (b), in the centre, stacks six labelled layers from Input through Embedding, Feature Selection, Two-Stream Feature Interaction (two trapezoids) and Fusion up to the pCTR output. Orange dashed leader lines tie the Feature Selection box to panel (a), which shows two mirrored gates (MLP, sigmoid, 2x, element-wise product) driven by user and item features, and tie the Fusion box to panel (c), which shows bilinear fusion as a sum tree and its multi-head variant with chunking. Pastel fills, serif labels, no bitmaps.
